limitations: Exact order-by-order claims are restricted to integer orders 2 through 17; outside that range only the monotonic lower-bound corollary is stated.
The exhaustive finite calculation invokes Allouche's published exact paperfolding factor-complexity theorem for infinite-position completeness.
The result is for the regular paperfolding word, not all generalized paperfolding words.
Unindexed earlier statements or independently computed tables are a residual originality risk.
scientific_integrity: The attached standalone checker exhausts all factors at eight anchor orders using two independent digit formulas and two finite-factor representations. The remaining orders follow by a proved monotonicity lemma; no extrapolated factor counts or independent certification is asserted.
title: Sharp uniform anti-power radii for the first seventeen orders of the regular paperfolding word
